title: Find every book on your school list
description: Upload a PDF, DOCX, photo, or text file. We extract the required titles, compare them with the catalog, explain missing books, and show available seller options by price.

upload.title: Drop your school list here or choose a file
upload.help: Clear, straight photos and original PDF or DOCX files produce the best results.
upload.privacy: Your document is sent securely to OpenAI only when you press Analyze. It is used to identify the books in this list.

camera.title: Photograph your school list
camera.description: Place the full page inside the frame, keep it flat, and use good lighting for accurate text recognition.
camera.crop_description: Remove the table, floor, shadows, and other background so AI can focus on the document.
camera.crop_help: Drag across the photo to select the document area.
camera.crop_error: The selected area could not be cropped. Please draw the crop again and retry.
camera.permission_denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings and try again.
camera.unavailable: No usable camera was found on this device.
camera.secure_context: Camera access requires HTTPS or localhost.
camera.error: The camera could not be started. Close other apps using it and try again.
camera.capture_error: The photo could not be captured. Please try again.

processing.ocr: Analyzing Arabic, English, and French content with AI…

results.empty_filter: No books are present in this category.

reasons.no_catalog_match_title: This title is not in the catalog
reasons.no_catalog_match: We found no sufficiently close book. Check the extracted title or ask an administrator to add it.
reasons.no_available_copy: The book is known, but there is currently no available seller copy.

selection.title: Selected books
selection.empty: Choose a seller option under each matching book. The lowest prices are shown first.
selection.notice: Selection does not reserve a copy yet. Ordering and reservation can be connected as the next workflow.

review.title: Review extracted document text
review.help: Review the AI transcription here, correct any mistake, then run matching again.

errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 15 MB.
errors.pdf_page_limit: PDF files are limited to 10 pages per AI analysis.
errors.unsupported_file: This file type is not supported. Use PDF, DOCX, TXT, JPG, PNG, or WEBP.
errors.empty_document: No readable text was found. Try a clearer photo or a higher-quality document.
errors.parser_unavailable: The document reader could not load. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.server_error: The document was read, but catalog matching failed. Please try again.
errors.unknown_error: We could not read this document. Please try another file.
